description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned. We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform. Together we own the stack from the app on the merchant's device, through checkout and commerce services and merchant identity, down to the money movement that settles and pays out funds. We are taking over end-to-end ownership of these services, so you will learn the platform properly, then run it. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles. Advises immediate management on project-level issues Guides junior engineers Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions Minimum Qualifications: 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Your way to impact Set the technical direction for services spanning checkout, commerce, identity and money movement. Reduce operational and financial risk in payment, settlement and payout flows through better design, automation and observability. Build trustworthy data pipelines (Python, Spark, Airflow, BigQuery) that give Finance, product and merchants accurate, timely numbers for settlement, payouts, reconciliation and merchant insights. Lead the Zettle-to-PayPal convergence work on the backend, including the move of legacy merchants onto PayPal One Identity and the integration with PayPal core payments through the TAP API. Grow the team: mentor engineers, review designs, and make knowledge transfer from Sweden stick. Your day to day Lead design and delivery of larger changes such as new payment flows, integrations and migrations, writing clear design documents and decision records. Design, build and operate batch and incremental data pipelines using Python, Apache Spark and Airflow, landing curated datasets in Google BigQuery from our Java services and event streams. Own pipeline reliability: idempotent and re-runnable jobs, backfills, data quality checks, lineage, SLAs for data freshness and cost control on Spark and BigQuery. Act as incident commander for your domain; run post-incident reviews and drive the fixes. Own SLOs, alerting and capacity for your services; work with SRE and PayPal platform teams. Review code and designs for the team, and coach engineers at CL5 and below. Partner with product, Finance, security and compliance on payments, settlement, payouts and reconciliation. Run knowledge-transfer sessions with Sweden and ensure every critical service has at least two people who can operate it. What do you need to bring- 4 to 7 years of software engineering experience, with deep Java expertise (Spring Boot, Dropwizard) and a record of owning production services. Must have: hands-on Python and Apache Spark for large-scale data processing, Apache Airflow for orchestration, and Google BigQuery for modelling, querying and optimising analytical data. Experience designing reliable data pipelines: idempotency, backfills, schema evolution, data quality checks, monitoring and cost and performance tuning. Proven design of distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including multi-region and failure-mode thinking. Strong knowledge of payments: authorization, capture, refunds, clearing, settlement, chargebacks and reconciliation. Experience with ledgers, payouts or bank connectivity is a strong plus. Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope, key management and secure access to sensitive data. Experience leading cross-team technical work, mentoring, and handling incidents as lead. Nice to have: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) integration (data extensions, Journey Builder, API or SFTP data feeds), GraphQL federation, OAuth and identity migrations, PSD2/SCA, EU payment schemes (such as Swish or Vipps). Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden. A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records. Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product. title: Software Development Engineer - Agentic Data Infrastructure, Partner Data And Analytics
description: DESCRIPTION The Data Services team within PDNA (Partner Data And Analytics) builds and operates the Agentic Data Platform that powers Amazon's Selling Partner analytics infrastructure. We serve 900K+ Selling Partners and 30K+ Amazonians through 4,000+ standardized metrics, real-time streaming pipelines validated at Black Friday scale (142M+ events), and the Curated Data Layer (CDL) — Amazon's strategic data infrastructure for Selling Partner GenAI applications including Seller Assistant, Supply Chain Expert, MCF, and ISS. We are building the future where intelligent agents autonomously operate data pipelines, serve analytics through MCP servers, and enable self-service insights at scale. You will build the infrastructure layer that sits between raw data and intelligent agents. Think of it as the operating system for agentic data — the MCP servers agents call, the query engines they reason through, the schema contracts they interpret, the streaming backbone they react to, and the validation services they trust. This is systems engineering applied to the agentic AI problem: you are not building agents — you are building the infrastructure that makes agents possible. Key job responsibilities 1) Design and build MCP servers and data access APIs 2) Engineer the real-time streaming backbone using Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka/MSK, Kinesis, and Lambda that powers agentic workflows. 3) Build agent orchestration infrastructure — the tool registries, execution planners, state stores, and handoff protocols that enable specialized agents (ingestion, validation, delivery) to coordinate across the data operations lifecycle. 4) Develop trust and validation infrastructure that keeps agent-generated outputs reliable 5) Extend the lakehouse for agentic consumption — building metadata contracts, schema registries, and catalog APIs on top of our Iceberg-based infrastructure that agents can reason over autonomously. 6) Own your systems end-to-end — design, build, test, deploy, operate, and document. Your infrastructure will be observable, self-healing, and resilient. You will participate in on-call, drive root-cause analysis, and permanently resolve operational issues. 7) BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, Lucene/SOLR or Storm/Samza experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience Proficiency in one or more systems languages (Java, Python, Kotlin, TypeScript, Scala, or Rust) Experience designing and operating production services — API design, distributed system patterns (consistency, partitioning, fault tolerance), and service-oriented architectures Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and system design Experience with data infrastructure — lakehouse architectures (Iceberg), query engines (Athena, Trino), or metadata/catalog systems PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with agentic AI infrastructure — tool registries, agent orchestration, LLM integration, or agent state management Familiarity with GenAI infrastructure patterns (RAG, embedding stores, evaluation frameworks) Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
